{{Quote|This may prove to be useful if we meet up with any arachnors.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="PDS">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref>}}
A '''stun cannon''' (or '''stun-cannon''') was a weapon that fired [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blasts. A heavy stun cannon was mounted on the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[SecuriTech]] [[Espo Walker 101]].<ref name="HSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Optional upgrades to [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] could include four forward-mounted stun cannons.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] brought a man-portable stun-cannon with him to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arzid]] to deal with any [[arachnor]]s they encountered, though it became separated from him when such an encounter occurred.<ref name="PDS" />
